snippet.title: Contract Rush DX - LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
ITS OUT, RIGHT NOW!! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1775960/Contract_Rush_DX/

Contract Rush DX is a hand-animated 2D Shoot 'Em Up, with multiple playable characters. Explore the world, collect powerful upgrades throughout levels, and unleash them to defeat difficult boss battles!
